fusions.name: Stokehole Blast
fusions.desc: Blasts everything within 3.5 tiles ahead of you, which deals 12 damage and leaves each enemy [Burning] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Bursting Clinker
fusions.desc: Throws a brick that deals 32 damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Hard Glaze
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% and your fire resistance by 15% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Kiln-Hot Float
fusions.desc: Conjures a float still hot from the kiln. It increases your weapon damage by 12% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. You have 8% fire resistance.
